STEP 3 - Items: Lettuce/leafy greens (main item, curly green leaves); a darker leaf piece or stem fragment underneath (likely the same green leafy item, possibly a bit of wilted leaf). No visible dressing, oil, or sauce.

STEP 6 - Grams: Leafy greens 392 ml x 0.15 g/ml ≈ 59 g. Darker leaf pieces 10 ml x 0.15 ≈ 2 g. Total ≈ 61 g.

STEP 7 - Energy: Cooked/raw lettuce ≈ 15 kcal per 100 g. 61 g x 15 kcal/100 g ≈ 9 kcal.

STEP 8 - Sanity check: A small pile of a few lettuce leaves on a large plate should weigh tens of grams and carry very little energy. About 60 g and ~9 kcal is plausible for what is visible.
